core.headline: Detached house with pool, triple garage and 2.1 acres
core.summary: A four-bedroom detached house built in 1987, set in approximately 2.1 acres within the Kent Downs National Landscape and Metropolitan Green Belt, with indoor swimming pool and triple garage.
core.listing:
A four-bedroom detached house built in 1987, set in approximately 2.1 acres within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. The plot is accessed by driveway and includes a triple garage.

The house provides three reception rooms and benefits from oil-fired central heating. An indoor swimming pool is housed within the property.

The accommodation comprises four bedrooms and three bathrooms across the floors.

The grounds extend to approximately 2.1 acres and include the triple garage.

The property is situated on Pilgrims Way, Wrotham TN15.

Guide Price £1,250,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band G (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (metered). Sewerage: Mains. Heating: Oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: Good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: Driveway. The property is within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt.
keyFeatures: Within the Kent Downs National Landscape and Metropolitan Green Belt
